migration_flags.description: account.move.line.analytic_account_id (Many2one to account.analytic.account) was removed in v16. Absent from v19. Replaced by analytic_distribution JSON field.
migration_flags.action: Migrate all references from analytic_account_id to analytic_distribution {'account_id': 100} format.

migration_flags.description: analytic_tag_ids (Many2many) and the account.analytic.tag model were removed in v16. Entirely absent from v19.
migration_flags.action: Remove all references to analytic_tag_ids and account.analytic.tag. Tag-based distribution logic must be reimplemented via analytic_distribution JSON.

migration_flags.description: account.analytic.account.parent_id (hierarchical chart-of-accounts style) was removed in v16. Accounts are now flat; hierarchy lives on account.analytic.plan via parent_id + _parent_store.
migration_flags.action: Remove customisations relying on account.analytic.account parent_id. Implement plan hierarchy on account.analytic.plan instead.

migration_flags.description: account.analytic.line no longer has a fixed set of analytic columns. Each root plan creates a dynamic ir.model.fields entry (x_plan{id}_id). The project plan maps to the fixed account_id column.
migration_flags.action: Any customisation or report referencing fixed analytic columns other than account_id must be updated to use _column_name() resolution or the analytic_distribution JSON on move lines.

migration_flags.description: _validate_distribution() in analytic.mixin only fires when validate_analytic=True is in the ORM context. It is NOT triggered on every write. account.move.line._validate_analytic_distribution() calls it at posting time.
migration_flags.action: Custom models that use analytic.mixin must explicitly set validate_analytic=True in context when performing mandatory validation.

key_findings.account_structure: account.analytic.account is FLAT (no parent_id). Hierarchy is on account.analytic.plan via _parent_store.
key_findings.plan_column_mechanism: _strict_column_name() returns 'account_id' for project plan, 'x_plan{id}_id' for others. _sync_plan_column() creates ir.model.fields dynamically.
key_findings.distribution_format: JSON dict where keys are string account IDs (comma-separated for multi-plan combined entries) and values are float percentages.
key_findings.mandatory_validation: _validate_distribution() checks each mandatory plan sums to 100% using float_compare with decimal.precision 'Percentage Analytic'. Only fires when validate_analytic context is True.
key_findings.analytic_line_creation: _create_analytic_lines() on account.move.line called at posting: validates then creates one account.analytic.line per distribution entry per move line.
key_findings.plan_domain: _get_plan_domain() returns [('plan_id', 'child_of', plan.id)] — includes accounts from all descendant plans.
key_findings.applicability_scoring: Plan applicability resolved by score: 0.5 base + 1.0 for business_domain match. Company match alone cannot override a domain-specific rule.
key_findings.migration_critical: analytic_account_id (Many2one), analytic_tag_ids (Many2many), and account.analytic.tag model ALL removed in v16. Version 19 has none of these.
key_findings.distribution_model: account.analytic.distribution.model auto-prefills analytic_distribution on new documents based on partner/partner_category/company matching.
